concept.display: Consent for Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
concept.definition: The Pilgrim consents to share his-her International Patient Summary (IPS data) during the  provision of clinical care at Ministry of Health-Saudi Arabia in Haj District area healthcare facilities through the Hajj-1446/2025 event as any follow up care that might be needed from any healthcare practitioners
<INSERT TEXT FROM INDONESIA: discuss pilgrims's consent to utilize Satusehat to enable access to KSA to their IPS if they are in need of care during Hajj>

The Malaysian Hajj pilgrim has provided consent for sharing the International Patient Summary (IPS) generated from the data recorded during the Hajj pilgrim health examination, as well as the vaccination records stored on MySejahtera to Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
<INSERT TEXT FROM OMAN: discuss pilgrims's consent to utilize Oman's e-Health Portal to enable access to KSA to their IPS if they are in need of care>

Fictional example, used by this guide's examples and the pilgrim's journey: the Onesan pilgrim consents to Onesa's health information exchange releasing the International Patient Summary (IPS), generated from the data recorded during the pre-pilgrimage health examination, to the Ministry of Health of Taifafeki for clinical care during the pilgrimage. Onesa (ISO 3166-1 user-assigned code XXK) is not a real country; this code is modelled on CONSENT-MYS.

Fictional example, used by this guide's examples and the pilgrim's journey: the pilgrim consents to share his-her International Patient Summary (IPS) during the provision of clinical care at Ministry of Health of Taifafeki healthcare facilities through the pilgrimage, and any follow-up care that might be needed from any healthcare practitioners. Taifafeki (ISO 3166-1 user-assigned code XXR) is not a real country; this code is modelled on CONSENT-KSA.
